name: career-match-holdout-benchmark-v0.3
disclaimer: Synthetic resume/job pairs constructed for a frozen holdout evaluation before Career Match hybrid-matcher development. Not real candidate data. Not production hiring labels. Not production ground truth. Relevance grades are manually specified synthetic relevance judgments, not independently validated ground truth. No independent annotator agreement. Intended for controlled model comparison only. v0.3 was created before development or tuning of the future Career Match hybrid matcher and should remain frozen during that milestone. Legacy CSV category labels are not used.

provenance.constructed_for: controlled model comparison before hybrid-matcher development
provenance.freeze_note: v0.3 was created before development or tuning of the future Career Match hybrid matcher and should remain frozen during that milestone.

comparison_note: v0.1 is a sanity-check fixture. v0.2 remains the development/error-analysis benchmark. v0.3 is the frozen holdout benchmark for comparing Lexical Baseline Matcher v0.1, Semantic Matcher v0.1, and a future Hybrid Matcher. Do not tune models against v0.3.

relevance_scale.3: strong match — right role family, required work and seniority largely present
relevance_scale.2: moderate match — related role or partial skills; plausible interview with gaps
relevance_scale.1: weak match — overlapping tools or adjacent family, wrong core responsibilities or seniority
relevance_scale.0: mismatch — different occupation; includes keyword-stuffing and unrelated stacks

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Seeking a Machine Learning Engineer with four or more years to design, train, and productionize predictive modeling systems. Day-to-day work centers on Python, PyTorch, and scikit-learn, plus packaging training jobs for inference services. Docker, Git, and Linux are required; public cloud platforms and container orchestration are preferred. This seat owns model quality and launch readiness, not weekly business dashboards and not pure application CRUD services.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Applied AI Engineer to integrate foundation-model capabilities into product workflows. You will ship Python services that call hosted models, add evaluation harnesses, and expose RESTful services for internal clients. Git and Docker are expected. Three or more years building AI-backed features. We are not hiring a research scientist to invent new architectures, and we are not hiring a dashboard-only analyst.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Data Scientist for causal product experiments and predictive modeling on tabular customer data. Core tools are Python, pandas, SQL, and scikit-learn with reproducible Git workflows. Three or more years. Not a deep-learning research lab role and not a frontend component seat.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Data Analyst responsible for recurring stakeholder reporting from relational data stores. Expect heavy SQL, light Python cleaning, and Git for report definitions. Two or more years. We do not need neural network training, inference services, or React interfaces.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Backend Engineer with four-plus years delivering RESTful services in Python (FastAPI preferred), relational data stores, Docker packaging, and Linux hosts under Git review. Ownership covers reliability and data access layers. Not a predictive modeling role and not a UI engineering role.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Full-Stack Engineer delivering TypeScript React experiences and Python RESTful services in one team. SQL and Git required. Three or more years across UI and service boundaries. Not an MLOps platform role and not a research NLP seat.

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer
jobs.description: MLOps Engineer to operate model serving and inference services on public cloud platforms. Stack emphasizes Python automation, Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes), AWS, Git, and Linux. Four or more years. You productionize others training artifacts rather than inventing new model families. Not a React product role.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer building batch pipelines into analytical warehouses. Daily tools include Python, SQL, relational data stores, distributed processing (Spark), workflow orchestration, Docker, and public cloud platforms. Git required. Three or more years. Need trustworthy pipelines, not narrative KPI storytelling and not neural architecture research.

jobs.title: NLP Engineer
jobs.description: NLP Engineer focused on text understanding systems: tokenization, sequence models, evaluation, and packaging for inference services. Python, PyTorch, and NLP libraries are core; Docker and Git required. Three or more years. Not a general backend CRUD seat and not a BI reporting seat.
